393.0: \DMother\T\W2\T\W2\TMother. I\Nknow Father died in a terrible\Naccident\W2\ABut you think it was because he didn't\Nbelieve in the gods? Nonsense, I say!\N
393.1: \DMother\T\W2\T\W2\TMother.\NIt is fine that you still revere and\Nworship the gods.\ABut you have carried your belief too\Nfar. You strive to discover too much\Nabout the gods you worship.\AYour faith has transformed into\Nan obsession\W2\N
393.2: \DMother\T\W2\T\W2\TMother.\AI told you. I warned you! Everyone\Nhas secrets. Even the gods themselves.\N\AAnd when you strive to expose\Nthose secrets\W2I asked you to be\Ncareful. I begged you, Mother\W2
393.3: \DMother\T\W2\T\W2\TMother.\NThey are searching\W2They are\Nlooking for me.\AWill they kill me, too? Will they burn\Nme at the stake for my blasphemy?\N\AI don't want to die\W2so I have no\Nchoice but to run, fast and far\W2\N\A\T\W2\T\W2Goodbye, Mother.\N\N
393.4: \DMother\T\W2\T\W2\TMother.\NI have found myself to possess the\Npower to cure horrid nightmares.\AAnd, as I helped those afflicted with\Nthis curse, I learned the truth of our\Nexistence.\AWe are not governed by a god, but\Nrather, a demon adorned in light to\Nappear as a god.\AHe alone is the cause of the terrible,\Ndeadly nightmares.\N\AAt last, Mother, I have beheld what\Nyou did\W2and it\W2it frightens me.\N
393.5: \DMother\T\W2\T\W2\TMother.\NI have found him at last. The demon\Nresides near this cursed village.\AHe has paralysed these poor folk with\Nfear\W2They are as cattle being led\Nto the inevitable slaughter.\AIf they only knew what I do,\NMother.\W2\NIt is my duty to destroy him. I will not\Nfail, Mother. I cannot fail\W2\N

394.0: \CHaven't seen you in a while,\Nkiddo!\AWhat are you going to have to\Ndrink\W2wait, don't tell me\W2\NCold milk!\ABwah, hah, hah! I'm just so very\Nwitty! I kill myself!\N
394.1: \CBeat it, kid. I have socks that are\Nolder than you.
394.2: \CHow about a drink on the house,\Nbuddy?\999\Y
394.3: \CHeck, I'll pour you as many glasses\Nof water as you want!\ABwah, hah, hah! Oh, man, that was\Na good one!\N
394.4: \C\W2\T\W2\TOh, I get it. Still suck\Nmamma's milk, huh? Bwah, hah,\Nhah!\AGet it? Mother's milk? As in\N\W3You're a baby?\W4\N\ADon't make me explain these gems\Nto you, kid! They're not as funny\Nthe second time!
394.5: \CDamn it. I won 81 times as much on\Nroulette\W2\999\Yumm\T\W2\T\W2?\AHey, you're the kid from the Klark,\Naren't you? This isn't a place for\Nsomeone your age.\AIt's barely a place for someone\Nmy age. You should go\W2\N
394.6: \CI hate roulette.\NI love roulette.\A\999\YThere's got to be a pattern. It\Ncan't just be dumb luck\W2\N
394.7: \CNot now, son. I'm busy drinking\Nenough liquor to forget how\Nmuch money I lost.
394.8: \CI'm sorry. I didn't see your ticket.\A\999\T\T\W2\T\W2\THey, Chain!\NThis kid is cool.
394.11: \CDon't get too rowdy. I'm not\Nas nice as I look.
394.12: \CI just won a bunch of Gilder\Nplaying the shooting game\W2\AAnd winning always makes me\Ngenerous. How 'bout a drink on\Nme?\999\Y
394.14: \CHey, will you pour a drink for\Nmy friend here?
394.15: \CSure I will \W2\T\W2\T\W2\T\W2\AHere you go. One glass of genuine\N100 proof Captain Merrick's Inoa\Nspiced rum.
394.16: \CHey, kid. Have a sip. It'll put hair\Non your chest. \AWell, either that or it'll burn all\Nof it off\W2\N
394.17: \CThe Captain has searched for the\Nlegendary Gilded Falcons since he\Nfirst set out to sea.\AEven now, he still seeks them. If\Nyou have any, I'm certain he'd be\Nmost interested\W2
394.18: \CHey, kid. You\W2you were on\Nboard the Klark, weren't you?\NRemember me?\NI was in the room next to your\Ncabin. What do you mean,\Nno?!\AYou must have suffered a head\Ninjury in the wreck. I still\Nremember that horrible storm.\AAnd the screams\W2oohhh\W2\ABut the good captain and me\Nsurvived. He lives south of Inoa, now.\AMakes a good living selling\Ntreasures, he does. You should\Nlet him know you're okay.\AHe's still haunted by the screams\Nof the crew and passengers who\Ndidn't survive\W2
394.19: \CThis is no ordinary drinking\Nestablishment.\AGo down the stairs in the back\Nto find a fully equipped, state\Nof the art casino.\AWhy, just the other day, I won\Nfour games of roulette in a row.\NAin't that cool?
394.20: \CI just can't pop those targets like\NI used to. Getting old is hell on\Nthe reflexes, kid.\AGuess I should play a game more\Nmy speed\W2like herbal laxative\Nroulette\W2Whoopee.
394.21: \CYou been paying attention to the\Nroulette table? Check it out\W2\AIf someone wins four in a row,\Nthe wheel always stops on black.\NThat thing is rigged!
394.22: \CIt's the gaming sensation that's\Nsweeping the nation! Slime\NBusters!
394.23: \CPop quiz, hotshot! Think you\Ncan win at Monster Shooting?
394.24: \CGo ahead. Bet your life savings\Non roulette! You know you\Nwant to!

396.3: \BTo open the Sluice Gate, both switches\Nmust be activated simultaneously.
396.4: \CI am Berue. My wait for your arrival\Nhas spanned more than a millennium,\NReleaser.\AI will show you the 5 signs which\Nbind this world.\N
396.10: \CThe gate will only open to the one that\Nshows me the signs. Reveal them to me\Nor depart from this place forever.
396.11: \CI have beheld the Sign of Harmony.\NNow reveal the Sign of Trust.
396.12: \CI have beheld the Sign of Trust.\NNow reveal the Sign of Wisdom.
396.13: \CI have beheld the Shining Sign\Nof Wisdom. Now, Reveal the Sign\Nof Love.
396.14: \CI have beheld the Sign of Love.\NNow you shall reveal the Sign of\NCourage.
396.15: \CI have witnessed all the signs of the\Ntrue Releaser. Now, I shall open the\Ngate which we crafted for you.\AStand between the pillars to enter\Nthe portal of warped time and\Nspace, Releaser!
396.21: \CBehold, Releaser! This is the silent\NSign of Harmony.
396.22: \CBehold, Releaser! Look upon the\Npure Sign of Trust.
396.23: \CLook closely, Releaser! This is the\Neternal Sign of Love.
396.24: \CMark and remember, Releaser! This\Nis the shining Sign of Wisdom!
396.25: \CBehold, Releaser! Look upon the\Nstalwart Sign of Courage.

398.0: \CHoo dawg! This is a pleasant surprise!\NIt looks as if I finally have a paying\Ncustomer!
398.1: \CYou goin' buy somethin', or you just\Ngonna stand there lookin' stupid?
398.2: \CI reckon that tree blocking the bridge\Nmusta up'n disappeared, I do. I'm\Nthinkin' business is gonna pick up!
398.3: \CEverythin' in Lurvy's shop is one of\Na kind, uh-huh. An' don't go thinkin'\N'bout gettin' no better prices elsewhere!
398.4: \CWhat in blazes are ya doin'? Are ya\Ntryin' ta bed me, ya shameless\Npervert?!\AGet outta my bedroom! Don't make\Nme come up there!\N
398.6: \CYou ain't told my little secret to\Nnobody, and I 'preciate that. Thank\Nye.\AI reckon I got to keep your secrets,\Ntoo, uh-huh, I do.\N
398.7: \CThat there Medicinal Herb'll run you\N4 Gilder. Okay?\0100\Y
398.8: \CA Strength Tonic'll run ya 12 Gilder\Nthese days. Soun' like a deal?\0100\Y
398.9: \CA Magic Elixir costs 24 Gilder.\NYa still in the market for one?\0100\Y
398.10: \CI reckon I should charge 600 Gilder\Nfer that Wonder Essence, but I'll give\Nit ta ya fer only 500. Want it?\0100\Y
398.11: \CWhatsa matter? Ya dull or somethin?\NI reckon you ain't got space in your\Nbag fer nothin' else like that, mister.
398.12: \CYou ain't got enough Gilder, and this\Nstuff ain't for free. No way, no how.
398.13: \CWhere you goin'?! You ain't tryin' ta\Nrob me, are ya?
398.14: \CWhat you doin', boy?! Get outta my\Npersonal, private 'zecutive quarters!
398.17: \CGood eyes, boy. That there's a Leather\NVest of Armour.  Hasn't been popular\Nsince the Village Boys went out\W2\AIt's a steal of a deal, at only 120\NGilder, 'specially since that retro\Ncraze is 'bout ta kick in. Deal?\0100\Y
398.18: \CI don't need that thing no more 'cause\N\W2I'm too old to care! 400 Gilder'n\Nthe durn thing's yurs. Want it?\0100\Y
398.20: \CYou're a purty smart shopper, boy.\NGot you some good deals. Uh-huh.
398.21: \CI seen a lotta things, boy, but that's a\Nnew one on me. Uh-huh. Was the door\Ntoo hard to open? Um hmm?
398.22: \CI guess you figured out what I do\Nhere. Uh-huh. Go 'round town and\Ncollect garbage...\AI fix it, then I sell it. I ain't proud of\Nthat fact.\N\AAnd, I'd 'preciate it if ya didn't tell\Nnobody, seein' as I jus' got right in\Nthe head.
398.23: \CTell yew what. Ya need somethin'\Nfixed, bring it on in. I'll make it right\Nfor free\W2
398.24: \CI reckon I'd 'preciate it if you'd be so\Nkind as to use my front door from\Nnow on!
398.25: \CStrange things you're sellin'.\0101\NLemme see here\T\W2\T\W2It's old,\Nbut I can fix it. Should I get started?\0100\Y
398.26: \C\W2\T\W2\TYa wanna keep it a hunk of junk?\NI reckon you can do whatever catches\Nyour fancy with it!
398.27: \CCan't just give to it ya. Nuh-uh. How's\N'bout a measly 2163 Gilder?\0100\Y
398.29: \CBeen a long time since I banged\Narmour. Did a damned fine job, too.\NUh-huh, I did.\A\0101Purty, ain't it\T\W2\T\W2makes\Nme proud.
398.30: \BLurvy takes the dilapidated old\Narmour quite eagerly.
398.32: \CGet back in the store, ya wise-crackin'\Ncity-dweller!\N
398.33: \CFree of charge, just like I told ya.
398.37: \CWhat you doin'?! Don't be makin' a\Nmess, boy! I'll slap ya back inta\Ndiapers 'fore ya know what hit ya!
398.38: \CI reckon you better stop foolin'\N'round 'fore I give you a whuppin'!

399.0: \EWUKIKI! They are trapped! Furless\Nones cannot resist to try strange\Nswitches.\A\W2\T\W2I will let you have this!\N\N
399.1: \EMUKIKI? He has come this far\W2\NSummon all our brothers!
399.3: \EWe will watch with joy as the\Nfurless ones cower in fear before us!
399.12: \EMmmm\W2yes, good it is!\AThe mushrooms refresh our tired\Nbodies and free our clouded head\W2
399.14: \EA furless one! He has come to take\Nour sacred mushrooms as Reiner\Nof the Swamplands once did!
399.15: \EMUKIKI! He dares to enter our\Nsecret den!\AI must report this transgression\Nto Lord Zazan at once!\N
399.16: \EThe Stone Golem stands ready.\NAttack the invader and crush\Nhim without mercy!
399.21: \EWelcome, furless one!\AWelcome to the end of your\Nmiserable life!
399.22: \EHmmm\W2the furless one will\Nnot give his life so easily\W2\N\ANo matter. Our reinforcements will\Nwipe the floor with his warm,\Nsticky life fluid.
399.23: \EWhee\W2this is good! The finest\Nmonkey wine I have ever tasted!
399.24: \EWe will guzzle no wine before\Nit's time\W2
399.25: \EWUKIKI\W2A furless one? Here\Nto hijack this lovely liquid from us?
399.26: \EDream more, furless one. We\Nwill not give this wine to one so\Nugly!
399.28: \EThere's no way you can hope to\Ndefeat me, furless one! NO\NPOSSIBLE WAY!

400.1: \BIf your determination is as one with\Nthe four of us\W2 The path shall be\Nswiftly opened to you\W2
400.2: \BBecause your will is strong, I shall\Ndirect you to the next path. Use insight\Nto discern my meaning\W2\ABehold what the master of the keep\Nspeaks!\W2\N
400.3: \BI am Ultorinde, a daughter of Elna.\NYou have earned my blessing.
400.4: \BI am Grimgelde, a daughter of Elna.\NYou have earned my blessing.
400.5: \BReceive blessings from the four\NGoddesses, then bare your courage\Nat the throne.
400.6: \BYou have received the blessings of\Nthe four sisters of Elna. Therefore,\Nthe path to destiny shall be revealed.
400.7: \BI am the master of this haven for those\Npure of heart.\N\AAre you truly\W2the one who seeks\Nthe path of truth and salvation?\N\0999\Y
400.8: \BIf what you say is true, you must let\Nthe guardians of this holy place know\Nof your determination.\AProve thy worth!\N\N
400.9: \BThis place holds no secrets for one\Nso cold of heart. Be gone!
400.10: \BReleaser! Follow the path of true\Nrighteousness and you shall not be\Nleft wanting\W2
400.11: \BThe letters \W3S\W0W\W0 E\W0 N\W4 are\Nengraved on the wall.
400.13: \CYou have proven your courage in\Ncoming here, Releaser\W2\AHowever, courage alone shall not\Nend in salvation. You must also be\Na strong warrior.\AYou shall face a test of strength,\NReleaser! I pray that you are truly\Nstrong enough to succeed!
400.14: \CYou are a truly worthy of the power\Nyou possess. Your courage shall not\Ngo unrewarded.
400.16: \BThe great sun's gaze is held fast\Nby his shimmering reflection on\Nthe water.\ATurning away with regret, he\Ncasts a glance upward at the starry\Nsky where brother moon resides.
400.19: \B\N\HAlundra's Experience Version\N\A\N\H\W3Ancient Sanctuary\W4\N\AThe goal is to obtain the\Nlegendary weapon sealed inside\Nthe sanctuary.\ABecause it's the middle of the\Nscenario, the degree of difficulty is\Nhigh.\AThere is no time limit.

401.54: \BWith the blessing of the Four\NGoddesses, show my kingdom\Nyour courage.
401.55: \BYou are the one who has been\Nblessed\W2Let me show you the\Nway!
401.56: \BWithout a key to unlock it, there's\Nno chance of it moving.
401.58: \C\W2\T\W2\T\W2\T\W2\T\W2\T\W2\AHe that treads foolishly into the sacred\Nkeep shall reap the pain of a thousand\Ncrushed souls!
401.59: \CHear my words, Releaser. I have\Ncome to be known as Jeal. I am also\None of the seven guardians\W2\AI was a metalsmith who sought to\Nunderstand the mysteries of life.\N\ATo stop the evil present in the mortal\Nrealm, I sacrificed my human form\Nand vanished into time. \AI have given thought to trusting the\Nlight of your soul to save this weary\Nland.\AHowever,\W2\T\W2\Tyou must bear\Nin mind that to defeat Melzas is to\Nrisk the end of reality itself!\A\W2\T\W2\T\W2\T\W2If you can bear\Nthat risk, proceed.\N
401.69: \BThe lettering on the tombstone\Nhas worn over time.
401.70: \BLet the light of guidance show the\Nsign of contact\W2
401.71: \BPlease give me the life which is\Nborn of fire\W2
401.72: \BBless the destroyer of evil who\Nhides within the flowing waters\W2
401.73: \BYou petition the guardians to\Nopen the doors.\ARight Door:\AAsk the one up and on the other side.\N\ACentre Door:\AAsk the one to the left and at the\Ntop class and the one on the right\Nsecond from the bottom .\ALeft Door:\AAsk the one closest.
401.81: \BThe wall is flawed by a deep fissure.
401.83: \CI see\T\W2\T\W2it has all become\Ncrystal clear\W2You are the\NReleaser, Alundra.
401.84: \COne who's inner strength and resolve\Nis as potent as yours is a rare find,\Nindeed.\AIf you have resolved to fight to the\Ndeath, you may be able to challenge\NMelzas himself.
401.90: \EThis pump is the heart of our great\Nwaterway. We will never allow one\Nto destroy it! Die, trespasser!
401.91: \BThere is a distant sound of gurgling\Nwater.
401.92: \BThe water is too deep. Further access\Nis impossible\W2
401.95: \DI am at once amazed and proud that\Nyou have progressed this far,\NReleaser.\AI am Stenia, Queen of the waters.\NYour actions have been shown to\Nmy heart by the rivers and oceans.\AOver the course of human history,\Nthere have been many gods.\N\ANot long ago, there was a race of\Ngiant gods called the Gazeck.\N\AYou have met one of them\W2Nirude.\NThe Gazeck were carved from stone\Nby the hands of ancient humans.\AThe seven Gazeck were revered and\Nfeared by the ancients\W2\N\ASoon, their prayers gave life to the\NGazecks. They literally became\Nwhat humans believed them to be.\ABut the Gazeck did not want to share\Nthe power of human prayer.\N\AThey fought each other for it\W2they\Nkilled each other for the prize of\Nhuman adulation.\AAll but one of them perished. \TOnly\NNirude declined to fight his fellow\Ngods.\AHe watched with a heavy heart as his\Nbrothers slaughtered one another.\N\ABut when the killing subsided, Nirude\Nfound that he was a god no more.\N\AThe ancient humans had long since\Nlost faith in the warring Gazeck.\N\AAnd, a god cannot exist without the\Nfaith of others\W2\T\W2\T\W2\T\W2\N\ASoon, another god was born from the\Nprayers of the people.\T That one was\T\N\W2Melzas.\ABut he was not the god of eternal\Npeace for which the humans had\Nprayed.\AHe was even more flawed than the\NGazecks had become, using fear to\Ngain the faith of humans.\ABut Melzas feared the wisdom of\Nhumans. He knew that they could\Nstrip him of power.\ATherefore, he began slaying\Nwhomever seemed to threaten his\Nexistence.\ASomehow, you have managed to\Nescape his machinations to this\Npoint\W2\A\W2\T\W2\T\W2\T\W2
401.96: \DMelzas has been watching us,\NAlundra. He has used my own water\Nagainst me\W2Take this, Alundra!
401.97: \DMelzas will soon destroy this\Nplace.\A\999\Y\ALeave here, Alundra! You must\Nhurry! The destruction comes!\N
401.98: \BA low rumble of falling rocks can\Nbe heard.
401.100: \BHe that does not fear the flame\Nshall gain mastery over it for\Nall eternity.
401.101: \CWhat have we here?\AYet another greedy human seeking\Nto claim the power of flame for\Nhimself?\AAll right, foolish one. Let's play a\Ngame of skill with my ball of\Neternal damnation!\APrepare to come to terms with your\Nlimitations, human!\N
401.103: \CYou're different from those that\Nhave come before\W2but you have\Nnot proven yourself worthy, yet.\AFollow the course of wisdom\Nemblazoned within your very soul\Nto meet your destiny.
401.104: \CIn the shadow of flame your\Npath must lie, until the time the\Nmotion dies\W2
401.105: \CIf you fail to finish upon the sign\Nof the flame, the power shall not\Nremain yours to command.
401.107: \CYou have indeed proven yourself\Na master of the flame! Take this\Nas proof of your mastery!
401.108: \CMay the power of flame never\Nleave your command!

410.98: \BA low rumble of falling rocks can\Nbe heard.

410.105: \CIf you fail to finish upon the sign\Nof the flame, the power shall not\Nremain yours to command.
410.107: \CYou have indeed proven yourself\Na master of the flame! Take this\Nas proof of your mastery!
410.108: \CMay the power of flame never\Nleave your command!

Ya look\Na might pale\W2\T\W2\T\W2\T\W2\AHmmm\W2you've been having the\Nsame troubling dream every single\Nnight?\AAye, It's the seasickness fogging\Nyour land lubbin' mind. 412.1: \CWhat ya be wantin', boy? Have ya\Nforgotten where yer cabin is\Nagain?\999\Y

412.3: \CGood. If ya were to ask me again, I'd\Nlock ya inside of it until we reached\Nport!
412.4: \CBeautiful, eh? I've been a sailor since\NI was a lad younger'n you\W2\A\W2An' I haven't yet tired of watching\Nthe waves roll across the pristine\Nwaters beneath the bow\W2
412.5: \DYou're headed for the village of\NInoa? That's a good distance from\NTorla, as I recall.\AWhat kind of business takes you to\Nsuch a remote place?\N
412.6: \CI'm returning to my beloved. I've\Nnearly forgotten how it feels to hold\Nher in my arms\W2\AAnd what of you? Why do you travel\Nto Torla?\N\A\W2\T\W2\T What? Your dreams led you to\Nthis ship? You ain't one of them freak-\Nboys, are ya?
412.7: \DI can't tell you how weary I am of\Nlooking at the sea and clouds for\Ndays.\AI'll be so happy to be on dry land\Nagain\W2\N
412.8: \CYou're making me nervous, kiddo.\AGo lie down for a while. Why not have\Nyourself another one of those freaky\Ndreams while you're at it!
412.9: \CYa best be taking the Captain's advice,\Nboy. I'll wake ya when the harbour is\Nin sight.
412.10: \CI think ya best be headin' back to yer\Nquarters, boy.\AThe horizon's looking dark as night,\Nand the sea's turning a might restless.\NThere's a storm brewin'\W2
412.11: \DThe ocean breeze is suddenly so cold\N\T\W2\T\W2I'm wondering if I should\Nhead inside before I catch a chill!
412.12: \D\W2\T\W2\TI had a dream. I remember\N\W2yes\W2we've been tricked!
412.13: \CYou must ask Jess\W2No, you must\Ndemand of Jess that he create a new\Nsword.\999\Y\AI don't want to die, Alundra. I want to\Nlive. Forever if it were possible.\998\Y\N\ABut defeating the demon is far more\Nimportant than any one life, including\997\Y\Nmy own.\996\Y
412.14: \C\W2This is the Holy Sword. I began work\Non it shortly after Lutas died\T\W2\T\W2\AWith this weapon, Alundra, you can\Nrestore peace to our world once and\Nfor all.\AYou can't let the sacrifice Lutas made\Nbe for naught!
412.15: \CListen to me. \TDon't think about this\Nvillage, or the people who live here.\AThink only of the demon you're about\Nto face. Think of how you plan to\Ndestroy him.
412.16: \FWell\T...\T...\TIt's finally here.\AI can't believe they didn't listen to me...
412.19: \CStand fast, everyone! I've sailed this\Nship through storms twice as\Nferocious!\999\Y
412.20: \CAye, listen to the Captain! The lady\Nof the sea could never raise a swell\Nstrong enough to polish off the Klark!\999\Y
412.22: \CCap...Captain!\1000\Y We're headed\Nstraight for the reef! Hold on! Sweet\Nmother of god, we're\W2 \999\Y
412.23: \CThere's a crack in the wall? \AWell, I'll be sure to fix it as soon as\Nmy friend and I finish this bottle of\Ngrog\W2\A\W2or when monkeys fly out of\Nyour arse. Whichever comes first,\Nsissy boy.
412.24: \CYou were screamin' in your sleep\Nagain last night, boy. I coulda sworn\Nya were on fire!
412.25: \CThere's a crack in the wall? \AYeah, yeah, yeah. What's the rush to\Nfix it? I'm in no hurry\W2\N
412.26: \CLast night I heard ya screamin' as if\Nyer soul was ablaze, boy! I tell ya, kid,\Nyer givin' me the shakes!
412.27: \CYou're feeling seasick? Arrr! Drop\Nanchor over the side, boy! I just\Nswabbed the bloomin' decks!
412.103: \C\W2\W2I am the one known as Lars.\NI am a wizard, and one of the\Nguardians of the seal.\NThe time grows short before I am\Nbound once more\W2\N\999\Y
412.104: \CCan you hear me, Releaser?\1001\Y\NNorth of Inoa is a deep, dark lake.\NBelow its murky surface, a wretched\Ndemon has slumbered for 1000 years.\NNow, the foul beast stirs once more\W2\1002\Y\NWe stand on the threshold\W2\N\N\1004\Y\999\Y
412.105: \FYou make me laugh, feeble one!\NNo one has the power to stop me now!\NEspecially not a miserable human.\1001\Y\999\Y
412.106: \CTell me, then, Melzas.\1001\Y\NIf humans are so powerless, how is\Nit that prosperity is yours only by\Nmeans of their efforts?\1004\Y\999\Y
412.107: \F\W2Don't you understand, Wizard?\NHumans have long since ceased being\Nof use to me.\NTheir presence in my reality has\Nbecome nothing more than a thorn\Nin my side. Soon, I shall\W2\T\W2\T\W2\NWhy do you snicker, old man? Do you\Ndare to mock my judgement?\999\Y
412.108: \C\1001\YI laugh because\T\W2\T\W2you're afraid!\NYou talk of destruction, yet you fear\Nthe strength of humanity.\1001\Y\NWhy else would you come here\Nnow, to stop me from sending my\Nmessage of redemption?\1002\Y\NAdmit your cowardice, foul fiend!\1004\Y\999\Y
412.109: \FI am not so cruel as to steal away\Nthe last shred of hope from one\Ndrawing his final breath.\NBelieve what you will, Lars.\N\W2\T\W2\TBut do tell me about this\Nperson you call the Releaser.\NWhat is his name? Or\W2hers?\1001\Y\999\Y
412.110: \CMy time in this world has come to\Nan end, Releaser.\NBut, I have served my purpose. You\Nnow know of the great power locked\Nwithin you.\1001\Y\NHeed my words, Releaser\W2Travel\Nto Inoa. 412.111: \FHa, ha, ha\W2Today, it is Lars.\NTomorrow it is you, Releaser.\1005\Y\NAnd then, the end of mankind.\1005\Y\NIt is destiny...\1005\YIt is fate.\1005\Y\999\Y

421.4: \EI praise your lofty efforts in making it\Nthis far, infidel. However, I must\Nput an end to your folly here\W2
421.5: \EDo you sometimes hear the words\Nyet not understand? I said IT'S\NOVER!
421.6: \BThe switch must be activated to\Nallow passage.\APress each lever once, then twice\Nin alternating order to proceed.\N
421.7: \BThe engine room is directly below\Nthis area. The switches must be\Nactivated correctly to proceed.\APress the levers in this order to\Nactivate the switches: left, right,\Nleft, left, right, right.
421.8: \EYou will not succeed, infidel!\NBehold! Even how, your life\Nseconds are numbered!
421.9: \EDharmaka!\T\W2\T\W2\Tyou are much\Nmore resourceful than I had thought.\NTry this on for size!
421.10: \EDharmaka!\T\W2\T\W2\Tthat didn't seem\Nto work. How about we run away\Nlike girls!?
421.11: \FYou have desecrated the sanctity of\Nmy ancient home. You must be an\Nagent of Melzas\W2\AIt seems that you are not my enemy,\Nhowever. But, neither have you\Nproven yourself my ally\W2
421.12: \FSuch resourceful survival skills can\Nonly be\W2Wait\T\W2\Tthat crest!\NYou are the Releaser\W2
421.13: \FI am Nirude, Releaser. You must\Nknow that I am one of the seven\NGuardians.\AI stand alone as the sole survivor \Nof the giant tribe. \W2\T\W2\T\W2\N\AThe prayers of Miming and his\Npeople have sustained me these\Nmany years of solitude\W2\AHowever, even the power of prayer\Nhas its limitations.\N\APlease accept my apology for\Ndoubting you, Releaser.\N\AI sense the courage and sincerity\Nwithin your soul.\N\AHmmm, I see. Nava sent you, did\Nhe? That is excellent.\N\AIt proves he has chosen to fight\NMelzas at last!\N\AI have waited for that confrontation\Nfor many, many years. I know you\Nshall emerge victorious!
421.14: \F\W2\T\W2\THmmm? Let me handle\Nthis, Alundra. Step back.
421.15: \FZorgia\T\W2\T\W2\T\NYou betrayed Wilda\W2\NYou betrayed the Gazeck.\AAnd now, you have taken the foul\Nside of Melzas.\N\AYou are a mercenary bastard,\Ndeserving only death!\N
421.16: \F\W2\T\W2\T\W2\T\W2\NTsk, tsk, Nirude. You have quite\Nthe sharp tongue today!\AHssss\W2Why must you use words\Nso sharp as to cause pain and hurt?\N\ABecause you once cared for me, I\Nplanned to spare you.\N\ABut now\W2your little speech has\Nchanged all that.\N\ALord Melzas has ordered your\Ndeath, and I'm now inclined to give\Nhim what he demands!
421.17: \FSuch an ugly scene. And, it's only\Ngoing to get uglier,\W2if I have\Nany say in the matter\W2\A\W2which, unfortunately for you, I\Ndo. Your turn Alundra. It's time to\Nbleed\W2
421.18: \FNot that I hold a grudge, of course.\NI'm just following the orders of my\Nlord and master, Melzas.\AA very prudent course of action,\Ngiven his power, wouldn't you\Nsay?\AIf you must hate someone, hate\NMelzas, not me. I'm just a pawn,\Nbound in gleeful servitude.
421.19: \F\W2\T\W2\THssss! Who alerted the munchkin\Nbrigade?!! They come!!\N\AAren't you lucky, Alundra. It\Nappears that your little friends have\Narrived to save the day!
421.20: \FThe time has come for me to depart,\NDreamchild. But rest assured that\NI shall find you and finish this\W2\AUntil then, Dreamer, lead a happy\Nlife without regret.\W2you never\Nknow when it will all end\W2
421.22: \ELet me tear out his quivering gullet\Nwith my bare hands!
421.23: \ENo! Hold him down so we can beat\Nhim to death!
421.24: \EKill him! Slay him! Pick him!\NSmash him!\N
421.25: \FNo\W2my children.\AThis is not the one who did\W2this\Nto me. The one you would condemn\Nis the only one that can save you\W2
421.27: \FIt's true, King Miming.\AHis power will save this land and\Nreturn peace to the hearts and\Nminds of all\W2
421.30: \FAlundra, you possess a strong name\Nthat shall serve you well.\APlease take another thing that will\Nserve you in like manner.\N\AHere is my crest. Melzas sent his\Nminions to retrieve it, but they failed.\NUse it to destroy him!
421.31: \F\W2\T\W2\T My material form is at\Nan end, my children. Leave here,\Nlest you perish as well!
421.33: \FHave faith in yourself, Alundra.\NDespite the hardships, you shall\Nprevail!
421.35: \ELord Nirude would want us to help\Nyou, Alundra. Please accept this gift\Nto help your quest\W2
421.37: \EWe would join you in your struggle\Nagainst Melzas, but we must keep\Nour defences up here.\ABesides, from what I witnessed of\Nyour skills, you don't require help\Nfrom such weak ones as us\W2\AGood luck, Alundra!\N\N

421.42: \EWe cannot let you live even one\Nmoment longer, assassin \W2\T\N\W2\Ttake this!
421.43: \EYou cannot run! Your only duty is\Nto DIE!
421.44: \EDharmaka! He's back!?\NPerhaps this will chill his blood!

421.52: \ELord Nirude is in grave danger\W2\NI will have to fight, irregularity or\Nno\W2
421.54: \EHeh heh\W2 You aren't too bright\Nto get caught in such a simple trap as\Nthis\W2\AOh well, live stupid, die stupid, I\Nalways say\W2\N
421.55: \BThe door is shut tight, and there\Ndoesn't seem to be any sort of\Nkeyhole.
421.56: \EWe have to protect Lord Nirude,\Neven at the expense of our lives!
421.59: \EHuh?\T\W2\T\W2\TAn invader?\NNo way!! I must report this to Lord\NMiming at once!
421.60: \EHe's travelled this far in the cave?\NActivate the trap at once!
421.61: \EAll right, that's IT!! No more\NMr. Nice Dwarf! This cannon\Nvolley should be the end of you!
421.62: \EDharmaka! You follow at the risk\Nof your life, infidel! You SHALL\Nperish!
421.63: \EYou're dead this time! Without a\Ndoubt in my superior midget mind!

478.107: \F\W2Don't you understand, Wizard?\NHumans have long since ceased being\Nof use to me.\NTheir presence in my reality has\Nbecome nothing more than a thorn\Nin my side. Soon, I shall\W2\T\W2\T\W2\NWhy do you snicker, old man? Do you\Ndare to mock my judgement?\999\Y
478.108: \C\1001\YI laugh because\T\W2\T\W2you're afraid!\NYou talk of destruction, yet you fear\Nthe strength of humanity.\1001\Y\NWhy else would you come here\Nnow, to stop me from sending my\Nmessage of redemption?\1002\Y\NAdmit your cowardice, foul fiend!\1004\Y\999\Y
478.109: \FI am not so cruel as to steal away\Nthe last shred of hope from one\Ndrawing his final breath.\NBelieve what you will, Lars.\N\W2\T\W2\TBut do tell me about this\Nperson you call the Releaser.\NWhat is his name? Or\W2hers?\1001\Y\999\Y
478.110: \CMy time in this world has come to\Nan end, Releaser.\NBut, I have served my purpose. You\Nnow know of the great power locked\Nwithin you.\1001\Y\NHeed my words, Releaser\W2Travel\Nto Inoa. Use your strength to stop\Nthe demon. I now travel to the next\Nworld\W2\1002\Y\N\T\W2\T\W2\T\W2Releaser!!\1005\Y\999\Y
478.111: \FHa, ha, ha\W2Today, it is Lars.\NTomorrow it is you, Releaser.\1005\Y\NAnd then, the end of mankind.\1005\Y\NIt is destiny...\1005\YIt is fate.\1005\Y\999\Y

480.1: \BThe rusty chain has fused and\Ncannot be moved.
480.2: \BAt the dinner party, people are seated\Nfrom the east side\W2\N\AThose of highest rank are seated first,\Nand those of lowest rank, last.\N\AThe King will be seated at the north,\Nand his subjects to the south.\N
480.3: \BTowers pierce the sky in the direction\Nwhere the light is born and dies.\AThe towers meant to control time are\Nin a deep slumber.\N
480.4: \F\W2\T\W2\T\W2\T\NYou are the one whom Lars termed\Nthe Releaser?
480.5: \FThe Guardians have become senile\Nin their old age\W2\AWhy else would they entrust the\Ncrests to a bumbling child such\Nas yourself?\AAh, well. That debate carries no real\Nmerit now. I have no time to ponder\Ntheir actions.\AYou have achieved the wonder of\Ngaining my full attention, trivial\None.\AAnd, now that you have come this far,\Nyou shall find that your fate is merely\Nto weep bitterly in the face of defeat!
480.7: \FMy bloodthirsty minions shall\Nsatisfy your death wish\W2behold!
480.8: \FWhy do you defer the fate that awaits\Nyou, boy? Submit to destiny and free\Nyour soul!\AFor no matter how many tears you\Ncry\W2 or how desperately you beg\Nfor mercy\W2\T\W2\TYou shall perish!
480.9: \FY\W2You! How dare you seek to\Nhumiliate me in my own sanctuary!\AFor your defiance, you shall drink\Nof the bitter cup of desolation I have\Nprepared, insolent one!
480.10: \FHow\T\W2\T\W2\THow can this be? How\Ncan an insolent child stand before a\Ngod?\ACurse you, Releaser! Curse you!!\NWithout you, the mortals would have\Nperished!\AInstead, I have come to this\Nhumiliating end at the hand of a mere\Nboy\W2
480.11: \FArrhhh! Your victory shall never\Nbe complete, Releaser!\AThe peace you and the other mortals\Nlong for shall never be fully\Nrealized.\AAs long as mortals harbour darkness\Nwithin their hearts, evil shall exist.\NIt is an incontrovertible fact\W2\AAnd darkness resides within every\Nmortal heart. Even yours, Alundra!\NGrahhhhhhhh!
480.12: \CAlundra! Your victory has nearly\Nbeen realised. Listen carefully to the\Nwords I speak!\AYou must burn Melzas' remains with\Nthe sacred fire to destroy him for all\Neternity!
480.13: \CYou have exceeded my expectations,\NReleaser. Well done!\ABut now is not the time to revel in the\Nsweet intoxication of victory.\N\ANow that Melzas has perished, the\Nsanctuary cannot remain standing\Nfor long.\AYou must escape before the walls\Ncollapse and the castle crumbles into\Nthe lake!
480.14: \CWhat's the matter, Alundra? Has the\Nstrain of battle addled your young\Nbrain?\AListen to the urgent message I bear!\NYou must burn Melzas' remains with\Nthe sacred fire!\AIt is the only way to destroy him for\Nall time\W2\N
480.22: \D\W2\TBergus, no! You must sleep\W2\Nyou have to dream!\AIf you don't, Alundra's life will be in\Ngrave danger\W2\N
480.23: \EBut, Mum, I woke up because I heard\Nthe sound of Alundra's voice!\A\W2\T\W2\TYou must've heard it, too!\N\N
480.24: \DDear son, Alundra is not here. There\Nis no way you could have heard his\Nvoice!\AGo to sleep\W2quickly now!\W2\N\N
480.26: \DNestus\T\W2\T\W2\TWe don't have the time\Nfor this!\AAlundra went to do battle with\NMelzas to save the lives of the people\Nof this land\W2
480.29: \DIt's not\W2my imagination.\AI really can hear him! Alundra!\NIt's Alundra!
480.30: \CWith all due respect, Rumi, I think\Nyou and your children are still a little\Ngroggy\W2
480.34: \CWhat's going on? You aren't\Ndreaming, and yet you can see and\Nhear Alundra!
480.35: \DUh\T\W2\T\W2? Yes, I can see a light.\NSmall, but strong!
480.36: \D\W2\T\W2\TI think we succeeded!\AThis must mean that our dreams and\Nprayers reached Alundra's heart!
480.37: \DOh, Alundra\W2Please be careful!\NYou must return to us!
480.38: \DAlundra, you are a boy no longer.\NYou have grown into a strong, brave\Nman.\AEven Melzas will not stand before\Nyou for long\W2I can just feel it\W2\N
480.39: \CAlundra, I know you will fight\Nthrough the obstacles in your\Npath\W2be strong!
480.40: \CJess is looking down upon you and\Nsmiling, Alundra. He knows you\Nshall deliver us from evil.
480.41: \EHey, you! Don't doubt yourself!\NI\W2believe in you!
480.42: \DMy prayers and my heart are with\Nyou\W2please take strength from that!
480.43: \CI can hear your cries of victory\Nalready!
480.44: \DAlundra, can you hear our voices?\NAnd,\W2 our prayers?
480.45: \EIf we can hear his voice, he must be\Nable to hear ours!\W2\T\W2\TAlundra!\APromise me you'll come back to us!\N\W2\T\W2\TPromise!\N
480.46: \ENo way Melzas can beat Alundra!\NHe's too strong\W2and too cool!
480.48: \EYou must emerge victorious! I'm\Ncounting on your skill!
480.49: \CYou have risked your life to fight for\Nours.\AIf anyone deserves our adulation, it's\Nyou, Alundra\N\AFor you are truly a deliverer from our\Ndark, cold night\W2\N
480.50: \DOh, Alundra, my heart is filled with\Nregret\W2\AI should have gone with you, even\Nthough you did not want me to risk\Nmy life.\ANow I can only wait here to see if\Nyou live or die\W2\Toh, Alundra!\NFor my sake, you MUST live!
480.52: \BAlundra hears and feels the voices\Nof his friends and their prayers\W2
480.53: \BThe thoughts of the united villagers\Nheal Alundra's wounded body and\Nrefreshes his soul\W2
480.56: \DThe long night has at last come to an\Nend. You are the sun, Releaser!
480.57: \CI will picture items in my mind and\Ntry to send them to you\W2
